run_migrate_imports_dry_run: run a dry run of the import migration script on a directory to preview changes
run_migrate_imports_execute: run the import migration script to replace old fairchem import paths with new ones
run_migrate_imports_single_file: run the import migration script on a single Python or YAML file to update imports
refactor_replace_strings_in_file: refactor the replace_strings_in_file function to support additional file extensions beyond YAML and Python
review_mapping_dict: review the mapping dictionary to add new import path migrations for fairchem modules
